title: Child Development: School Age
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Child Development: School Age - Certificate of Achievement (12-17 units)
outcomes: Identify developmentally appropriate curriculum and explain principles and practices pertaining to child development.
Examine the connections among child, families, and communities in child development.
Design, implement, and evaluate curriculum activities that are appropriate for school age children in a before and/or after school learning environment.
Formulate developmentally appropriate positive guidance strategies for working with school age children in a before and/or after school learning environment.
Examine school age development as it relates to the individual as well as actions and attitudes in a group setting.
careers: working with school age children in before and after school and enrichment programs
